title: Rebalancing and cluster change
brief: Move replicas, data and software while continuing to preserve one authoritative history.
outcomes: Explain catch-up and safe membership change
Budget movement and decommissioning without using lost redundancy as capacity
entry: Sharding, replicated authority and regional failure budgets.

neighbours.RL128: Owns CockroachDB node health and removal.

heading.title: A live copy
heading.brief: Copy a partition while writes continue; distinguish snapshot transfer, ordered catch-up and the handover boundary.

heading.title: Changing the voting set
heading.brief: Show why simply replacing membership can admit incompatible authorities; explain overlap or learner/catch-up rules as protocol-dependent mechanisms.

heading.title: Planned removal
heading.brief: Follow drain, replica relocation, quorum checks and final decommission; include temporary disk, network and failure headroom.

nested_article.title: Operating and securing a CockroachDB cluster
nested_article.brief: Operate a secure CockroachDB cluster with evidence about identity, range health and planned removal.
outcomes: Verify secure runtime identity, least privilege and tenant isolation
Diagnose under-replication and remove a node without losing the survival budget
nested_article.entry: For security: general least privilege and trusted application/tenant ownership (RL104); the needed secure deployment and SQL object/session context is introduced locally. For node health/removal: also CockroachDB ranges (RL123), general rebalancing and the topology’s survival budget (RL109).

heading.title: Versions during change
heading.brief: Separate binary rollout, on-disk or cluster compatibility and finalisation; introduce product upgrade rehearsals without treating rollback as always available.

nested_article.title: Upgrading a CockroachDB cluster
nested_article.brief: Rehearse CockroachDB’s binary rollout and cluster-version boundary with explicit return limits.
outcomes: Distinguish mixed binaries from finalised compatibility
Verify rollback eligibility, application acceptance and recovery choices
nested_article.entry: General cluster change, CockroachDB ranges, secure operations including the prepared node-health branch, and backups.
